name: Freshman Physicals
overview:
Freshman Physicals is a themed series produced by the Carnal Plus studio, structured around the premise of sports medical exams and health evaluations for young adults. Episodes typically take place in settings that simulate doctor's offices or physiotherapy clinics.

The narrative of each volume focuses on the interaction between a character playing the role of a healthcare professional (doctor, nurse, or trainer) and a "freshman" or athlete in need of a physical assessment. The progression of the scenes follows a pattern where simulated clinical protocols—such as checking reflexes, heart rates, and abdominal exams—serve as an introduction to the intimate and consensual involvement between the participants.
